path: 11 Sal de Solana y Corrosion/4 NOTA TÉCNICA DE ALIA SOBRE CORROSIÓN/AECP2017-A-002_Corrosion of Lointek heat exchangers’ U-tubes due to exposure to molten nitrate salt in Solana powerplant_v00.pdf
title: AECP2017-A-002 Corrosion of Lointek heat exchangers’ U-tubes due to exposure to molten nitrate salt in Solana powerplant v00
summary:
- Document purpose: Estimate corrosion loss of Lointek's U-tubes due to molten nitrate salt exposure.
- Material: SA210 A1 Seamless (general carbon steel), Wall Thickness: 1.651 mm / 0.065 in
- Corrosion rate driven by chloride ions and temperature, increased by x3.8 with a 50ºC increase of salt temperature.
- Assumptions: Total lifetime = 25 years, design temperature correction factor = 1.52
- Total expected corrosion loss: 63.08 µm (3.8% of initial thickness)
- Thickness loss due to corrosion estimated at 0.06308mm
- Corrosion loss considered low (3.8% of initial tube thickness)
- Additional structural calculation needed after 25 years
- References include studies on A516GR70 steel and chloride content effects
